title: File:Wallsend colliery flare.jpg
desc:
A metal pipe (top left) discharges a "roaring" flame of methane gas from Wallsend Colliery, c.1840, illuminating the night scene.  Methane ("fire damp") was a major hazard at these "fiery collieries" and Wallsend had seen major explosions.
